description: Streams the official EPA ECHO Exporter and publishes source-designated active regulated-facility site and establishment candidates with address, ZIP, coordinates and precision metadata, classifications, program associations, provenance, exclusions, and explicit semantic limitations.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only the exact HTTPS /files/echodownloads/echo_exporter.zip path on echo.epa.gov.
retry: Network acquisition may be resumed by supplying a complete official archive; do not retry schema, duplicate-identifier, checksum, source-timestamp, or quality-gate failures without a new verified source snapshot.
checkpoint: The complete compressed source is retained and hashed before streaming normalization; publication is run-scoped and current.json changes only after all quality gates pass.
idempotency: Source Last-Modified date plus archive SHA-256 identify a release; FRS REGISTRY_ID creates stable provisional site and establishment candidates.
cancellation: Stop network and local streams cooperatively, close partition writers, leave unpublished run-scoped staging, and do not change current.json before complete publication.
retention_profile: Retain the immutable internal source archive and approved public normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
